groups.name: spring.fluent-query.lifecycle
groups.description: Optional Eloquent-style entity lifecycle hooks (not Active Record).

properties.name: spring.fluent-query.like-mode
properties.description: LIKE strategy: portable (UPPER+LIKE, all DBs) or oracle-unaccent (Oracle CONVERT US7ASCII).

properties.name: spring.fluent-query.lifecycle.enabled
properties.description: When true, EntityLifecycleRegistry dispatches EntityLifecycleListener hooks. Also use @EnableFluentQueryLifecycle so repositories use FluentQueryJpaRepository.
